amendments.reason: Approved by the user 2026-11-13 13:03 La Paz ('Approved HRRR amendment'), before any bulk download. The cloud one-field check (run 43467250285) showed ecCodes returns typeOfFirstFixedSurface as the text 'sfc' unless read as a number, so decode_grib rejected every APCP field. The fix reads the six identity keys as integers (codes_get(gid, k, int)); nothing else in plan10.py changed, and no rule, threshold, feature or statistic of PLAN10 changed. No feature value had been computed with the old code.
